as_told.title: James McDonald's 1957 sighting and Project Blue Book

plain: The physicist James McDonald is said to have seen a UFO himself at the Savannah River Site, a nuclear plant in South Carolina, and to have been pushed to the margins for taking the subject seriously. A former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo passes this on with some hedging: he thinks McDonald was at Arizona State, and he thinks the sighting was at Savannah River. Michels tells it twice himself, without naming a source. Once he says McDonald was made a public mockery of after the sighting, and once he calls the site a plutonium reactor. A researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala puts the sighting in 1957. He says McDonald reported it to Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and thought at first that things were going well. It matters to the tellers because it would mean a respected scientist saw something at a nuclear facility and suffered for saying so.
